note: 鳄鱼受击+死亡（同一条片段拆两段）。

parameters.prompt: The exact crocodile in the reference stands in place, then is struck by an invisible blow: it flinches once with the head and shoulders jerking back, then recovers and returns to the exact original pose and holds it for a moment. Then it is struck again and dies: the legs give way, the body sinks flat onto its belly, the head drops onto the ground, the jaws stay closed, and it lies completely still until the end. Keep the same three-quarter left view, scales, colours and head shape. Exactly four legs and one tail. No walking, turning around, rolling over, thrashing, second flinch, blood, wounds, open mouth. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, smears, glow, energy, coloured light, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shockwave, rings, shadow or text.

result.reviewNote: 抢救通过：2–10抬头后仰作受击（12起转成侧身，跳过，受击来回播放）；56–76趴倒四肢摊开作死亡，末段眼睛有一点红光。
